description: An operations console for a fleet of connected test and measurement systems in the Svelte 5 data grid: live status, a utilization sparkline, temperature, throughput, active alarms, firmware and calibration due date per system, with getRowId keeping identity stable under streaming updates. Select systems for bulk acknowledge-alarms or schedule-calibration actions, group by site with api.setGroupBy and expandAllGroups, read a KPI strip derived from the live data, use search and quick filters, and click a system for a master-detail view of its instruments and tags. Row and column virtualization keep it flat at fleet scale.

faq.question: Why does getRowId matter for live data?
faq.answer: With a stable id per row the grid can update a system in place when a new reading arrives, keeping selection, expansion and scroll position; without it a new array would look like new rows.

faq.question: How do bulk actions work?
faq.answer: onRowSelectionChange stores the selected rows; the toolbar buttons map over them to clear alarms or set a calibration date, then api.clearRowSelection() resets the checkboxes.

faq.question: How is the detail panel opened?
faq.answer: onRowClick sets the clicked system as selected when it has instruments, and a side panel renders its instruments and tags from that object.
